guidance: Share Repurchase Activity During the fourth quarter of fiscal 2026, TransDigm returned $943 million to shareholders through share repurchases totaling 820 thousand shares of its common stock at an average price per share of $1,150.
Year-to-Date Results Fiscal 2026 net sales increased 20%, or $1,726 million, to $10,557 million from $8,831 million in the comparable period a year ago.
Organic sales growth as a percentage of net sales for fiscal 2026 was 11%, and 13% excluding non-aerospace sales.
highlights: Quarter-to-Date Results Net sales for the quarter increased 23%, or $551 million, to $2,988 million from $2,437 million in the comparable quarter a year ago.
Organic sales growth as a percentage of net sales was 14%.
Net income for the quarter was $586 million, a decrease of $23 million, or 4%, compared to $609 million in the comparable quarter a year ago.

guidance: EX-99.1 2 fy2026_q4xerxex991.htm EARNINGS RELEASE Document Exhibit 99.1 November 17, 2026 To Our Shareholders and the Broader Investment Community, We closed fiscal 2026 with a strong fourth quarter.
Our strong fiscal 2026 results, delivered amid a challenging macroeconomic environment, show we are succeeding on that mission.
Revenues increased 16% for the fourth quarter to $25.9 billion from $22.5 billion in Q4 fiscal 2025.
highlights: We welcomed 4% more global guests at Experiences and increased engagement on our streaming platforms and across the ESPN networks(1), trends that support strong revenue growth.
Income before income taxes increased 71% to $3.5 billion from $2.0 billion in Q4 fiscal 2025.
Total segment operating income(2) increased 43% to $5.0 billion from $3.5 billion in Q4 fiscal 2025.

guidance: During the third quarter of fiscal 2027, NVIDIA returned $28.1 billion to shareholders in the form of shares repurchased and cash dividends.
Q3 Fiscal 2027 Summary Outlook NVIDIA’s outlook for the fourth quarter of fiscal 2027, which includes an additional week, is as follows: •Revenue is expected to be $130.0 billion, plus or minus 3%.
Beginning in the first quarter of fiscal 2027, NVIDIA’s non-GAAP financial measures no longer exclude stock-based compensation expense.
highlights: “Vera Rubin is off to an explosive start, our roadmap is on track and our ambition has never been greater.” In September 2026, NVIDIA’s Board of Directors approved an increase of $150 billion to the company’s share repurchase authorization, without expiration.
NVIDIA will pay its next quarterly cash dividend of $0.25 per share on December 23, 2026, to all shareholders of record on December 2, 2026.
